title: East Coast Severe Weather suburbs in impacted area - close 4 August
summary: This page provides information about the East Coast Severe Weather Personal Hardship Assistance payment and the suburbs impacted by the event.
intro:
To be eligible for the East Coast Severe Weather Personal Hardship Assistance payment, you must live in one of the listed suburbs within the Impacted Area.

Applications for payment for the suburbs listed on this page close 4 August 2025.

See the list of eligible suburbs where applications close 21 July 2025.

The list of eligible suburbs may be updated from time to time. The most recent update was made on 14 July 2025.
